summary: Completed testing of PHASE 3 features: PDF bulletin export, multi-day history chart (7 days), and server Web Push with VAPID. All 30 backend tests passed. All frontend UI elements verified working.

minor.issue: Transient httpx.ReadTimeout errors when Open-Meteo API is slow (not a code bug, external API latency)

context_for_next_testing_agent: PHASE 3 FEATURES TESTED: 1) GET /api/weather/history-days?days=7 returns ~8 entries with daily aggregates (precipitation_total, max_cape, storm_hours, etc). 2) GET /api/weather/history-days?days=14 returns ~15 entries. 3) Days parameter clamps to [1, 60]. 4) GET /api/push/vapid-public-key returns valid VAPID key starting with 'BG'. 5) POST /api/push/subscribe is idempotent (upsert by endpoint). 6) POST /api/push/unsubscribe removes subscription. 7) POST /api/push/test requires auth (401 without token), returns {sent, removed, errors, total} with auth. 8) GET /api/reports/bulletin.pdf returns valid PDF (>1KB, starts with %PDF). 9) Service worker at /sw.js is accessible (200). 10) Frontend shows 'Alertes in-app' toggle (data-testid='toggle-notifications'). 11) Frontend shows 'Push serveur (même fermé)' toggle (data-testid='toggle-push'). 12) Frontend shows 'Bulletin PDF' button (data-testid='download-bulletin-pdf') - opens PDF in new tab. 13) Frontend shows 7-day history chart (data-testid='history-days-chart') with daily bars, total precipitation, and storm days count.

backend_phase3: GET /api/weather/history-days?days=7 - returns 8 entries with date, precipitation_total, max_cape, max_lightning_potential, max_wind_gust, max_temperature, min_temperature, storm_hours
GET /api/push/vapid-public-key - returns {key: 'BGk0c301...'} valid VAPID public key
POST /api/push/test - requires auth (401 without), returns {sent, removed, errors, total} with auth
GET /api/reports/bulletin.pdf - returns application/pdf, content-disposition header, >1KB PDF bytes
frontend_phase3: data-testid='toggle-notifications' - 'Alertes in-app' toggle visible and clickable
data-testid='toggle-push' - 'Push serveur (même fermé)' toggle visible and clickable
data-testid='download-bulletin-pdf' - 'Bulletin PDF' button opens /api/reports/bulletin.pdf in new tab
data-testid='history-days-chart' - 7-day history chart with daily bars, shows precipitation, storm days count
service_worker: Service worker handles push events, install, activate, notificationclick

mocked_apis.note: All integrations are REAL: Open-Meteo (weather), Blitzortung (lightning), pywebpush (VAPID push)
